body: Third and last of the three matchmaking pools was explicitly a design gap (no rank model, MMR, or queue rules existed), so this pass writes docs/RANKED_MATCHMAKING.md rather than skipping to code against an undecided model. Recommends plain ELO (K=32 flat, starting 1000) over Glicko/TrueSkill -- the rating-uncertainty problem those solve doesn't exist yet in a symmetric 1v1-only pool with no team-composition variance. New redgarden_ranked_stats table, deliberately kept separate from casual player_game_stats (ranked rating and casual win/loss are different questions -- conflating them would corrupt the already-shipped casual leaderboard). Queue rules: widening rating-search-window matching, explicitly scoped as its own future build pass since it doesn't fit the existing spawn-on-fill apps/matchmaker binary as a bolted-on flag. Design only, no code landed. Golden-indexed as REDGARDEN-RANKED. All three S170-14 pools (bot games, player-only, ranked) are now either built+verified or properly designed. Commit 8b52e54.
title: Ranked matchmaking design pass (S170-14, 3/3 -- all pools now scoped)
